verdict.rationale: Auth0 offers programmatic tenant management outside the dashboard. The official MCP server can create apps, deploy Actions, debug logs and manage users "all without touching the dashboard." The official CLI manages tenant configuration and automates tasks, and a My Organization API supports in-app admin. None of this establishes that every UI capability is available through the API, and no public OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: an explicit Management API parity statement or full API reference covering every dashboard function, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on confirmation of UI/API parity.
